features.quote: Maximum 40 turns or until the model explicitly stops or loops identically for 5 turns.
explicit permission to give up after any number of attempts
Pre-define when to truncate a run (identical tool calls 5× or explicit refusal to continue) to avoid unnecessary cost.
40-turn limit + early stopping keeps total tokens manageable while still allowing observable trajectories.
